description: Quick factual lookup: a plain-language summary (abstract) plus up to 5 relevant links from DuckDuckGo instant answers and Wikipedia. Best for people, places, concepts, history and science. Returns links, not page content: to get the content of the top results in the same call, use search-read. Not for breaking news: use news-search. Params: query (required). Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"query":"x402 payment protocol"}.

query.description: Search query string (e.g. 'current Bitcoin price', 'capital of France', 'Next.js 15 release date')
